title: Welcome to Arenile
description: Create the owner user to get started: then we will guide you through the establishment setup.

fields.organizationHint: The name on your receipts, for example “Lido Azzurro srl”.
fields.name: Full name
fields.emailHint: You will use it to sign in. Arenile desktop sends no email and does not connect to the internet.
fields.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Keep it safe: you also need it on the other devices of the beach.

privacy: Your data stays on this computer, in the Arenile data folder.

validation.organizationRequired: Enter the name of the company or establishment.
validation.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
validation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.

errors.noToken: Open this page from the Arenile menu in the system tray (Open panel): the link carries a security code.
errors.tokenInvalid: The setup link is no longer valid. Close this tab and choose “Open panel” from the Arenile menu in the system tray.
errors.completed: The initial setup is already complete: sign in with the user you created.
errors.network: Arenile is not responding: check that the app is open and try again.
errors.generic: The user could not be created. Please try again.
